title: Radio in the Round
version: Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum article, 17 April 2019
lineage: Institutional design-history account, not a contemporary trade advertisement; establishes the earlier described configuration, without determining the novelty of the later receiver circuit or price.

passages.note: Describes Ekco’s plastic housings, circular molded Bakelite design and its introduction as the AD65 in 1934.
